1. (Currently amended) An apparatus, comprising: an encoder (300) configured to encode mode mapping information for a mapping between values of a mode index and modes available to encode at least a portion of a picture in a sequence of pictures, wherein the mode mapping information is adapted responsive to one or more actual parameters of the sequence, __wherein the encoder comprises a processor configured to execute instructions to determine the actual parameters from at least one of coding information for one or more previously coded pictures in the sequence, and to generate the adapted mode mapping information based on the determined actual parameters__.

7. (Currently amended) The apparatus of claim 1, wherein the adapted mode mapping information is updated after encoding one or more pictures of the sequence, __and wherein the encoder is further configured to signal the updated mode mapping information in a resultant bitstream__.

8. (Currently amended) The apparatus of claim 1, wherein the actual parameters are determined from at least one of coding information for one or more previously coded pictures in the sequence, a selected subset of a set of adapted mode mapping information relating to at least a portion of the sequence, one or more partial encoding passes for the picture, statistics of one or more pictures in the sequence, statistics of one or more portions of the one or more pictures in the sequence, and statistics of the sequence, __and wherein the encoder is configured to compute the statistics from the previously coded pictures__.

9. (Currently amended) A method, comprising: encoding (740, 970) mode mapping information for a mapping between values of a mode index and modes available to encode at least a portion of a picture in a sequence of pictures, wherein the mode mapping information is adapted responsive to one or more actual parameters of the sequence (740, 940, 960), __the method further comprising: determining, by a processor, the actual parameters from at least one of coding information for one or more previously coded pictures in the sequence; and generating, by the processor, the adapted mode mapping information based on the determined actual parameters__.

15. (Currently amended) The method of claim 9, wherein the adapted mode mapping information is updated after encoding one or more pictures of the sequence (550, 960), __and wherein the updated mode mapping information is signaled in a resultant bitstream__.

16. (Currently amended) The method of claim 9, wherein the picture is a currently coded picture, and the actual parameters are determined from at least one of coding information for one or more previously coded pictures in the sequence, a selected subset of a set of adapted mode mapping information relating to at least a portion of the sequence, one or more partial encoding passes for the picture, statistics of one or more pictures in the sequence, statistics of one or more portions of the one or more pictures in the sequence, and statistics of the sequence (940, 960), __the method further comprising: computing, by a processor, the statistics from the previously coded pictures__.

17. (Currently amended) An apparatus, comprising: a decoder (400) configured to decode mode mapping information for a mapping between values of a mode index and modes available to decode at least a portion of a picture in a sequence of pictures, wherein the mode mapping information is adapted responsive to one or more actual parameters of the sequence, __wherein the decoder comprises a processor configured to execute instructions to determine the actual parameters from at least one of coding information for one or more previously decoded pictures in the sequence, and to generate the adapted mode mapping information based on the determined actual parameters__.

23. (Currently amended) The apparatus of claim 17, wherein the adapted mode mapping information is updated after decoding one or more pictures of the sequence, __and wherein the decoder is further configured to extract the updated mode mapping information from a resultant bitstream__.

24. (Currently amended) The apparatus of claim 17, wherein the actual parameters are determined from at least one of coding information for one or more previously decoded pictures in the sequence, a selected subset of a set of adapted mode mapping information relating to at least a portion of the sequence, statistics of one or more pictures in the sequence, statistics of one or more portions of the one or more pictures in the sequence, and statistics of the sequence, __and wherein the decoder is configured to compute the statistics from the previously decoded pictures__.

25. (Currently amended) A method, comprising: decoding (820, 1030) mode mapping information for a mapping between values of a mode index and modes available to decode at least a portion of a picture in a sequence of pictures, wherein the mode mapping information is adapted responsive to one or more actual parameters of the sequence, __the method further comprising: determining, by a processor, the actual parameters from at least one of coding information for one or more previously decoded pictures in the sequence; and generating, by the processor, the adapted mode mapping information based on the determined actual parameters__.

31. (Currently amended) The method of claim 25, wherein the adapted mode mapping information is updated after decoding one or more pictures of the sequence, __and wherein the updated mode mapping information is extracted from a resultant bitstream__.

32. (Currently amended) The method of claim 25, wherein the actual parameters are determined from at least one of coding information for one or more previously decoded pictures in the sequence, a selected subset of a set of adapted mode mapping information relating to at least a portion of the sequence, statistics of one or more pictures in the sequence, statistics of one or more portions of the one or more pictures in the sequence, and statistics of the sequence, __the method further comprising: computing, by a processor, the statistics from the previously decoded pictures__.

33. (Currently amended) A __non-transitory__ computer-readable storage media having video signal data encoded thereupon, comprising: mode mapping information for a mapping between values of a mode index and modes available to encode at least a portion of a picture in a sequence of pictures, wherein the mode mapping information is adapted responsive to one or more actual parameters of the sequence, __wherein the mode mapping information is generated by a processor that determines the actual parameters from at least one of coding information for one or more previously encoded pictures in the sequence__.
